 Print Filmmaker Ashwiny Iyer Tiwari opened up in an emotional Instagram post after the Los Angeles premiere of 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend', helmed by her husband, Nitesh Tiwari . A special screening took place on October 27 at the David Geffen Theater, part of the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures, just ahead of the film’s global release on November 5. Ashwiny Iyer Tiwari shares throwback pic with Nitesh Tiwari
 Ashwiny posted a collection of photos from the night, one shows her and Nitesh alongside Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi . She also shared a throwback shot of the couple from their younger years, reflecting on the journey they shared and the long years of dedication that went into realising this ambitious film. Watch Ashwiny Iyer Tiwari talks about her life post 'Bareilly Ki Barfi' Ashwiny Iyer Tiwari’s note on dreams and magic
 Sharing her thoughts in the post, Ashwiny said, “Somewhere along the way, we begin to believe that magic happens. Life unfolds like a story, one thread of love, passion, and belief at a time of doubts, trials, loosing hope, rising again. And sometimes, the most beautiful dreams take shape when people chosen for you walk along, each bringing a piece of their own magic. Gratitude to the humans who follow their calling and dare to dream beyond what exists. ” She continued by reflecting on the patience, belief and personal sacrifices behind the journey. Ashwiny underlined how much collaboration matters, and how important it is to stay connected to one’s roots while representing Indian cinema on the world stage. “It’s Karma. It’s Belief. It’s egoless. It’s patience. It’s two parallel lives. It’s years of sacrifices. It’s silent conversations. It’s being alone inspite of loved ones around. It’s being your own cheerleader. It’s standing tall with gratitude of our roots on a world stage. It’s the divinity of creating together. From all of us. From India to the world. Our dream, finding its wings,” she added. Ashwiny wrapped up her post with the words, “Walking along on the side with Nitesh at The world premiere of Ramayana : Rise of a Legend on October 27, 2026, at the David Geffen Theater inside the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles, California.” 'Ramayana: Part 1' cast and release date
 'Ramayana: Part 1' stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. The first part will hit theatres worldwide on November 5, 2026, with the second part lined up for Diwali 2027.
